PhD in Industrial Engineering
Application Deadlines
Fall admission: International applicants must submit all materials by December 15, 2026. Domestic applicants: January 15.
Priority deadline for assistantships and fellowships: December 1.
Application Fee
The non-refundable application fee is $75 for all applicants. Application fee waivers are available for McNair Scholars and applicants with financial need.
English Proficiency
International applicants must submit TOEFL iBT (minimum score of 80), IELTS Academic (minimum overall band 6.5 with no band below 6.0), or Duolingo English Test (minimum 110).
Test Scores
The GRE is optional for Fall 2027 admission and not required.
Admission requirements
Applicants should have a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
Required documents: statement of purpose, CV, unofficial transcripts, and three letters of recommendation.
